documents.text:
# Garden journal

The tomato seedlings were moved to the greenhouse on March 3. They need watering every morning and a weak fertilizer once a week.

Aphids appeared on the roses in late May. A soap spray removed most of them within ten days.

The compost bin is turned every Sunday; it reached 60 degrees Celsius in June.

# Bicycle maintenance

The rear derailleur skipped gears because the cable had stretched. Turning the barrel adjuster a quarter turn counterclockwise fixed the shifting.

Tire pressure for the commuter bike is 65 psi front and 75 psi rear.

The chain was replaced at 3,200 kilometres after the wear gauge showed 0.75 percent elongation.

# Sourdough bread

Feed the starter twice a day with equal weights of flour and water. It is ready when it doubles within six hours.

Mix 500 g flour, 350 g water, 100 g starter and 10 g salt. Bulk fermentation takes about five hours at 24 degrees.

Bake in a covered Dutch oven at 250 degrees for twenty minutes, then uncovered for twenty-five minutes.

# Lisbon trip

The flight to Lisbon departs on 14 September at 07:40 from terminal 2. The booking reference is QX7P2L.

Tram 28 runs through Alfama; buy a Viva Viagem card at the metro station to save on fares.

The hotel near Rossio square offers breakfast from 7 until 10.

# Household finances

The electricity bill rose by 18 percent after the winter tariff change. The supplier contract renews on 1 November.

The emergency fund target is three months of expenses, about 9,000 euros.

Invoice 2026-114 for the roof repair was paid by bank transfer on 2 October.

# Running log

The half marathon plan has four runs per week, with one long run on Saturday.

Shin pain after the interval session was treated with rest and ice; the physiotherapist recommended calf raises.

A new pair of shoes was bought at 640 kilometres on the old pair.

# Project Atlas

Project Atlas migrates the billing service to the new event queue. The cut-over is scheduled for the second week of December.

Risks: duplicate events during replay and missing idempotency keys in the legacy client.

The weekly status meeting moved to Thursday at 15:00.

# Reading list

Finished The Left Hand of Darkness; the theme of trust between Genly Ai and Estraven stood out.

Started a history of the printing press that explains how movable type spread across Europe after 1450.

Next on the list is a field guide to mushrooms of the northern forests.

# Car

The car is due for its annual inspection in April. The last oil change was at 48,500 kilometres.

Winter tyres are stored at the garage on Mill Road and are swapped in late October.

# Kitchen renovation

The new countertop is quartz, 3 centimetres thick. Installation is booked for 20 November.

The dishwasher leaked from the inlet hose; tightening the clamp stopped the leak.
